---
title: "Install"
---

## Requirements

- Claude Code.
- A git repository. Without one, Kompreni can only use what the conversation edited, and says that coverage may be incomplete.
- Optional:
    - Python 3.9 or later, to check every quoted snippet and line reference against the repo. Without it, Claude checks by hand and says so.
    - [Quarto](https://quarto.org), for walkthroughs with tabs and code annotations, rendered to HTML. Without it, walkthroughs are Markdown, and code tours are written as `.qmd` but not rendered.
    - The GitHub CLI [`gh`](https://cli.github.com), to draw on pull requests when explaining a branch.
    - For the optional [mod](mod.qmd): a Claude Code version with mod support (tested with 2.1.331).

## Install from the marketplace

In Claude Code:

```text
/plugin marketplace add Bergam0t/kompreni-claude-code-skill
/plugin install kompreni@kompreni
```

That gives you `/kompreni:explain` and `/kompreni:walkthrough`.

### Optional: the buttons above the prompt

```text
/plugin install kompreni-offer@kompreni
```

This installs the [kompreni-offer mod](mod.qmd), which adds a row of buttons above Claude Code's prompt box.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Mods aren't sandboxed
A mod runs as code inside Claude Code. Read [`hooks/register.tsx`](https://github.com/Bergam0t/kompreni-claude-code-skill/blob/main/mods/kompreni-offer/hooks/register.tsx) before installing it.
:::

## Update

```text
/plugin marketplace update kompreni
/plugin update kompreni@kompreni
/plugin update kompreni-offer@kompreni    # if you have the mod
```

## Uninstall

```text
/plugin uninstall kompreni@kompreni
/plugin uninstall kompreni-offer@kompreni    # if you have the mod
```

## Try it without installing

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Bergam0t/kompreni-claude-code-skill
claude --plugin-dir kompreni-claude-code-skill
```

To try the mod too, add `--plugin-dir kompreni-claude-code-skill/mods/kompreni-offer`.
